fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-03-01, a white truck bearing registration number TN-01-XX-1057 belonging to the complainant was taken from Mullai Puram Parking Area. The time of the incident was given as 23:35 on 2025-03-01. Deepa Selvam approached Thanjavur Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000413. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Pandian Thangaraj, using the number 9000000427. The complaint refers to Revathi Ammal, a driver, reachable on 9000000164. Ezhilan Palanisamy (9000000181) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away from an industrial parking space at night.
